description: Read the CyberBrick app's renderer console, captured by this MCP server since it attached (ring buffer, 5000 lines; lines that mention tokens/keys/PINs/certs are never stored). Poll with since=<lastSeq> to follow long tasks such as flash_config with hardwareMappings (upgrade → send config → pairing). Per-message B0 traffic and keepalives are hidden unless includeNoise. Read-only.

grep.description: Case-insensitive regex filter on the line text.

includeNoise.description: Include per-message B0 traffic and keepalive lines.

limit.description: Max lines returned (the newest matching ones).

since.description: Return only lines with seq > since (use lastSeq from the previous call).

name: app_logs
